edits.old: SELECT account_id,app_id,CAST(occurred_at AS DATE) event_date,count(DISTINCT visitor_id) total_visitors,count(DISTINCT CASE WHEN page_id IS NOT NULL THEN visitor_id END) visitors_with_page_views,count(DISTINCT CASE WHEN num_events>0 THEN visitor_id END) visitors_with_feature_use,count(DISTINCT CASE WHEN num_minutes>=1 THEN visitor_id END) visitors_with_deep_engagement FROM staging.stg_pendo__event GROUP BY 1,2,3
edits.new: SELECT account_id,app_id,event_date,count(DISTINCT visitor_id) total_visitors,count(DISTINCT visitor_id) FILTER(WHERE pg=1) visitors_with_page_views,count(DISTINCT visitor_id) FILTER(WHERE ft=1) visitors_with_feature_use,count(DISTINCT visitor_id) FILTER(WHERE dp=1) visitors_with_deep_engagement FROM (SELECT visitor_id,account_id,app_id,event_date,max(CASE WHEN typ=1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) pg,max(CASE WHEN typ=2 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) ft,max(CASE WHEN typ=3 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) dp,count(DISTINCT entity_id) FILTER(WHERE typ=1) pages,count(DISTINCT entity_id) FILTER(WHERE typ=2) features,sum(CASE WHEN typ=1 THEN num_events ELSE 0 END)*.1+sum(CASE WHEN typ=2 THEN num_events ELSE 0 END)*.3+sum(CASE WHEN typ=3 THEN num_events ELSE 0 END)*.6+sum(num_minutes)*.05 engagement,sum(num_minutes) all_minutes,sum(CASE WHEN typ=1 THEN num_minutes ELSE 0 END) pgminutes FROM (SELECT visitor_id,account_id,app_id,CAST(occurred_at AS DATE) event_date,page_id entity_id,num_events,num_minutes,1 typ FROM staging.stg_pendo__event UNION ALL SELECT visitor_id,account_id,app_id,CAST(occurred_at AS DATE),feature_id,num_events,num_minutes,2 FROM staging.stg_pendo__feature_event UNION ALL SELECT visitor_id,account_id,app_id,CAST(occurred_at AS DATE),page_id,count(*),sum(num_minutes),3 FROM staging.stg_pendo__page_event GROUP BY 1,2,3,4,5) GROUP BY 1,2,3,4) GROUP BY 1,2,3

(SELECT avg(engagement) FILTER(WHERE pg=1) FROM (SELECT visitor_id,account_id,app_id,event_date,max(CASE WHEN typ=1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) pg,max(CASE WHEN typ=2 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) ft,max(CASE WHEN typ=3 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) dp,count(DISTINCT entity_id) FILTER(WHERE typ=1) pages,count(DISTINCT entity_id) FILTER(WHERE typ=2) features,sum(CASE WHEN typ=1 THEN num_events ELSE 0 END)*.1+sum(CASE WHEN typ=2 THEN num_events ELSE 0 END)*.3+sum(CASE WHEN typ=3 THEN num_events ELSE 0 END)*.6+sum(num_minutes)*.05 engagement,sum(num_minutes) all_minutes,sum(CASE WHEN typ=1 THEN num_minutes ELSE 0 END) pgminutes FROM (SELECT visitor_id,account_id,app_id,CAST(occurred_at AS DATE) event_date,page_id entity_id,num_events,num_minutes,1 typ FROM staging.stg_pendo__event UNION ALL SELECT visitor_id,account_id,app_id,CAST(occurred_at AS DATE),feature_id,num_events,num_minutes,2 FROM staging.stg_pendo__feature_event UNION ALL SELECT visitor_id,account_id,app_id,CAST(occurred_at AS DATE),page_id,count(*),sum(num_minutes),3 FROM staging.stg_pendo__page_event GROUP BY 1,2,3,4,5) GROUP BY 1,2,3,4) x WHERE x.account_id IS NOT DISTINCT FROM rates.account_id AND x.app_id IS NOT DISTINCT FROM rates.app_id AND x.event_date IS NOT DISTINCT FROM rates.event_date)::DOUBLE avg_engagement_score

(SELECT avg(pages) FILTER(WHERE pg=1) FROM (SELECT visitor_id,account_id,app_id,event_date,max(CASE WHEN typ=1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) pg,max(CASE WHEN typ=2 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) ft,max(CASE WHEN typ=3 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) dp,count(DISTINCT entity_id) FILTER(WHERE typ=1) pages,count(DISTINCT entity_id) FILTER(WHERE typ=2) features,sum(CASE WHEN typ=1 THEN num_events ELSE 0 END)*.1+sum(CASE WHEN typ=2 THEN num_events ELSE 0 END)*.3+sum(CASE WHEN typ=3 THEN num_events ELSE 0 END)*.6+sum(num_minutes)*.05 engagement,sum(num_minutes) all_minutes,sum(CASE WHEN typ=1 THEN num_minutes ELSE 0 END) pgminutes FROM (SELECT visitor_id,account_id,app_id,CAST(occurred_at AS DATE) event_date,page_id entity_id,num_events,num_minutes,1 typ FROM staging.stg_pendo__event UNION ALL SELECT visitor_id,account_id,app_id,CAST(occurred_at AS DATE),feature_id,num_events,num_minutes,2 FROM staging.stg_pendo__feature_event UNION ALL SELECT visitor_id,account_id,app_id,CAST(occurred_at AS DATE),page_id,count(*),sum(num_minutes),3 FROM staging.stg_pendo__page_event GROUP BY 1,2,3,4,5) GROUP BY 1,2,3,4) x WHERE x.account_id IS NOT DISTINCT FROM rates.account_id AND x.app_id IS NOT DISTINCT FROM rates.app_id AND x.event_date IS NOT DISTINCT FROM rates.event_date)::DOUBLE avg_pages_per_visitor

(SELECT avg(features) FILTER(WHERE ft=1) FROM (SELECT visitor_id,account_id,app_id,event_date,max(CASE WHEN typ=1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) pg,max(CASE WHEN typ=2 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) ft,max(CASE WHEN typ=3 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) dp,count(DISTINCT entity_id) FILTER(WHERE typ=1) pages,count(DISTINCT entity_id) FILTER(WHERE typ=2) features,sum(CASE WHEN typ=1 THEN num_events ELSE 0 END)*.1+sum(CASE WHEN typ=2 THEN num_events ELSE 0 END)*.3+sum(CASE WHEN typ=3 THEN num_events ELSE 0 END)*.6+sum(num_minutes)*.05 engagement,sum(num_minutes) all_minutes,sum(CASE WHEN typ=1 THEN num_minutes ELSE 0 END) pgminutes FROM (SELECT visitor_id,account_id,app_id,CAST(occurred_at AS DATE) event_date,page_id entity_id,num_events,num_minutes,1 typ FROM staging.stg_pendo__event UNION ALL SELECT visitor_id,account_id,app_id,CAST(occurred_at AS DATE),feature_id,num_events,num_minutes,2 FROM staging.stg_pendo__feature_event UNION ALL SELECT visitor_id,account_id,app_id,CAST(occurred_at AS DATE),page_id,count(*),sum(num_minutes),3 FROM staging.stg_pendo__page_event GROUP BY 1,2,3,4,5) GROUP BY 1,2,3,4) x WHERE x.account_id IS NOT DISTINCT FROM rates.account_id AND x.app_id IS NOT DISTINCT FROM rates.app_id AND x.event_date IS NOT DISTINCT FROM rates.event_date)::DOUBLE avg_features_per_user

(SELECT count(DISTINCT visitor_id) FILTER(WHERE all_minutes>=10 AND pages>=3 AND features>=2)::FLOAT/nullif(count(DISTINCT visitor_id),0) FROM (SELECT visitor_id,account_id,app_id,event_date,max(CASE WHEN typ=1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) pg,max(CASE WHEN typ=2 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) ft,max(CASE WHEN typ=3 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) dp,count(DISTINCT entity_id) FILTER(WHERE typ=1) pages,count(DISTINCT entity_id) FILTER(WHERE typ=2) features,sum(CASE WHEN typ=1 THEN num_events ELSE 0 END)*.1+sum(CASE WHEN typ=2 THEN num_events ELSE 0 END)*.3+sum(CASE WHEN typ=3 THEN num_events ELSE 0 END)*.6+sum(num_minutes)*.05 engagement,sum(num_minutes) all_minutes,sum(CASE WHEN typ=1 THEN num_minutes ELSE 0 END) pgminutes FROM (SELECT visitor_id,account_id,app_id,CAST(occurred_at AS DATE) event_date,page_id entity_id,num_events,num_minutes,1 typ FROM staging.stg_pendo__event UNION ALL SELECT visitor_id,account_id,app_id,CAST(occurred_at AS DATE),feature_id,num_events,num_minutes,2 FROM staging.stg_pendo__feature_event UNION ALL SELECT visitor_id,account_id,app_id,CAST(occurred_at AS DATE),page_id,count(*),sum(num_minutes),3 FROM staging.stg_pendo__page_event GROUP BY 1,2,3,4,5) GROUP BY 1,2,3,4) x WHERE x.account_id IS NOT DISTINCT FROM rates.account_id AND x.app_id IS NOT DISTINCT FROM rates.app_id AND x.event_date IS NOT DISTINCT FROM rates.event_date)::FLOAT high_quality_session_rate

(SELECT count(DISTINCT visitor_id) FILTER(WHERE NOT (all_minutes>=10 AND pages>=3 AND features>=2) AND NOT (all_minutes>=5 AND pages>=2) AND NOT (pgminutes>=1))::FLOAT/nullif(count(DISTINCT visitor_id),0) FROM (SELECT visitor_id,account_id,app_id,event_date,max(CASE WHEN typ=1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) pg,max(CASE WHEN typ=2 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) ft,max(CASE WHEN typ=3 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) dp,count(DISTINCT entity_id) FILTER(WHERE typ=1) pages,count(DISTINCT entity_id) FILTER(WHERE typ=2) features,sum(CASE WHEN typ=1 THEN num_events ELSE 0 END)*.1+sum(CASE WHEN typ=2 THEN num_events ELSE 0 END)*.3+sum(CASE WHEN typ=3 THEN num_events ELSE 0 END)*.6+sum(num_minutes)*.05 engagement,sum(num_minutes) all_minutes,sum(CASE WHEN typ=1 THEN num_minutes ELSE 0 END) pgminutes FROM (SELECT visitor_id,account_id,app_id,CAST(occurred_at AS DATE) event_date,page_id entity_id,num_events,num_minutes,1 typ FROM staging.stg_pendo__event UNION ALL SELECT visitor_id,account_id,app_id,CAST(occurred_at AS DATE),feature_id,num_events,num_minutes,2 FROM staging.stg_pendo__feature_event UNION ALL SELECT visitor_id,account_id,app_id,CAST(occurred_at AS DATE),page_id,count(*),sum(num_minutes),3 FROM staging.stg_pendo__page_event GROUP BY 1,2,3,4,5) GROUP BY 1,2,3,4) x WHERE x.account_id IS NOT DISTINCT FROM rates.account_id AND x.app_id IS NOT DISTINCT FROM rates.app_id AND x.event_date IS NOT DISTINCT FROM rates.event_date)::FLOAT bounce_rate

(SELECT avg(x.page_to_feature_conversion_rate) FROM rates x WHERE x.account_id=rates.account_id AND x.app_id=rates.app_id AND x.event_date>=DATE '2025-10-11'-INTERVAL 30 DAY) avg_30d_page_to_feature_rate

(SELECT avg(x.feature_to_deep_conversion_rate) FROM rates x WHERE x.account_id=rates.account_id AND x.app_id=rates.app_id AND x.event_date>=DATE '2025-10-11'-INTERVAL 30 DAY) avg_30d_feature_to_deep_rate
(SELECT avg(x.overall_conversion_rate) FROM rates x WHERE x.account_id=rates.account_id AND x.app_id=rates.app_id AND x.event_date>=DATE '2025-10-11'-INTERVAL 30 DAY) avg_30d_overall_conversion_rate

CASE WHEN avg_30d_overall_conversion_rate>=.3 THEN 'Excellent' WHEN avg_30d_overall_conversion_rate>=.2 THEN 'Good' WHEN avg_30d_overall_conversion_rate>=.1 THEN 'Fair' ELSE 'Poor' END funnel_health_rating

edits.old: 'Focus on feature discovery and onboarding' optimization_recommendation
edits.new: CASE WHEN avg_30d_page_to_feature_rate<.2 THEN 'Focus on feature discovery and onboarding' WHEN avg_30d_feature_to_deep_rate<.3 THEN 'Improve feature engagement and user guidance' WHEN NULL::FLOAT>.6 THEN 'Reduce bounce rate through better landing experience' ELSE 'Maintain current optimization efforts' END optimization_recommendation
